Epitome Aegidii from Lex Rom. Visigot. (ed. Haenel 228) XI 9, 1. The latter draws on C. Theodos. XI 31, 6; cf. Conrat (Cohn) Gesch. Röm. Rechts I 60. 224

suam fügt zu K Or; sua auch Interpr. Legis Rom. Visigoth., von Haenel für Hn’s Quelle gehalten; meist aber steht Hn näher zu Epit. Aeg. Nur die Interpret. copirte Will. Malmesbur. in Hs. Oxford Bodley Selden B 16 (ed. Stubbs I p. cxxxi); vgl. Conrat 232

suam added by K Or; sua also Interpr. Legis Rom. Visigoth., which Haenel took to be Hn’s source; but for the most part Hn stands closer to Epit. Aeg. Only the Interpret. was copied by Will. Malmesbur. in MS Oxford Bodley Selden B 16 (ed. Stubbs I p. cxxxi); cf. Conrat 232
